records.wording: NA27 (checked on the page image, p. 211).
records.reason: Class A−: Epiphanius (sch. 42) states that the whole parable of the two sons was not in the text. Tertullian passes from the coin (4.32.2) to the two masters (16:13, 4.33.1); Roth counts his silence as confirmation (tacitus). Restored by method (METHOD §11): by its words, the printed 15:1–2 sets two movements going: the sinners received, and the Pharisees and scribes grumbling "this man welcomes sinners and eats with them". The sheep and the coin answer the welcoming; only the parable of the two sons answers the eating ("let us eat and celebrate", 15:23) and the grumblers, in the elder son who will not go in and is pleaded with (15:28). The printed 15:7 and 15:10 name "a sinner who repents", but the sheep and the coin are found, they do not repent; the turn itself is shown only here: "coming to himself… rising, I will go to my father" (15:17–20). By its mechanics it is the text's fullest statement of the rising (ἀναστάς) that goes to the father, and of "was dead and is alive again" (cf. 24:5). Reading: docs/research/correspondence/word_by_word.md, chapter 13, test of 15:11–32; third_pass.md. Printed against Marcion's text: the witness states that the passage was not in it.

Restored by method (METHOD §11): by its words, the printed 15:1–2 sets two movements going: the sinners received, and the Pharisees and scribes grumbling "this man welcomes sinners and eats with them". The sheep and the coin answer the welcoming; only the parable of the two sons answers the eating ("let us eat and celebrate", 15:23) and the grumblers, in the elder son who will not go in and is pleaded with (15:28). The printed 15:7 and 15:10 name "a sinner who repents", but the sheep and the coin are found, they do not repent; the turn itself is shown only here: "coming to himself… rising, I will go to my father" (15:17–20). By its mechanics it is the text's fullest statement of the rising (ἀναστάς) that goes to the father, and of "was dead and is alive again" (cf. 24:5).
